lists.what: Top 10 innovation papers per problem community (alpha 0.5, medium) not yet cited by it
lists.hit: a paper published after the snapshot, assigned to the community (nearest frozen centroid), cites the work (or a known alias)

lists.what: Popularity baseline for bridge_paper: the 10 most cited innovation papers outside each community and not yet cited by it
Top 5 per community among papers cited at most once
Top 50 recent papers expected to be top-quartile for their year
lists.hit: top quarter of its publication-year cohort (frozen corpus papers of that year) for citations received after the snapshot: (a) global, OpenAlex counts_by_year; (b) from new papers in the field

lists.what: Baseline: the 50 most cited recent research papers so far
The cohort early_work is ranked within
Top 50 empty problem x method cells (alpha 0.5, medium)
lists.hit: at least 2 papers published after the snapshot fall in the cell (nearest frozen centroids)

lists.what: Baseline: empty cells with the largest row x column totals

lists.hit: (a) citations from the first community to the second at least triple per year after the snapshot; (b) a realized combination: a new paper whose problem is nearest the first community and whose method or innovation is nearest the second, whether or not it cites it

lists.what: Top 100 external works by the exp6 model (as of the latest complete year)
lists.hit: the share of new field papers citing the work in the 12 / 24 months after the snapshot is at least 1.5x its share in the three years before, with at least 3 citing papers

lists.what: Baseline: the 100 most cited by the field in the last 3 years
Recent papers in the top 5% of local momentum
lists.hit: the share of papers published after the snapshot inside the paper's 15-nearest-neighbour ball is at least 1.5x the share in the year before the snapshot

lists.what: Random baseline from the same papers
Clusters ranked by E' (direction: read with care)
lists.hit: the cluster's share of new papers after the snapshot is above its share in the three years before

lists.what: Every paper in the corpus at the snapshot: later papers are new
Regions where experiment B expects new communities to form
lists.hit: see exp8_birth.py: the region becomes dense with papers published after the snapshot

protocol.new_papers: Papers published after snapshot_date that are not in corpus_ids, collected by re-running the run's expansion routes with the same parameters (record the date and the route of each).
protocol.assignment: New papers get facets and embeddings with the frozen models above and are assigned to the nearest frozen centroid (cluster_centroids.parquet).
protocol.comparison: Each list is compared with its baseline_of list on the same hit definition: precision@k (per community where lists are per community) with a bootstrap over communities. Report every list, including the ones that lose.
protocol.no_peeking: The lists are not edited after this date; a change shows as a SHA-256 mismatch with the copy of this manifest in docs/snapshots/.
